dataExchangeHighlightsQuestion: Allow this app to save highlights with YouVersion?
dataExchangeHighlightsExplanation: YouVersion will ask you to grant access before highlights can be saved.
signInParagraph: {{appName}} wants to connect to your YouVersion Bible App account. This will allow them to see and interact with your Bible App activity. Would you like to proceed?
signOutPendingHighlightsExplanation: Some of your highlights haven't been saved yet, and they will be lost if you sign out. Do you want to sign out anyway?
signOutQuestion: Are you sure you want to sign out from YouVersion?
signOutExplanation: You'll need to sign in again to access your highlights.
